orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.mid: Central decision point for the entire agent system. Decomposes tasks, delegates, and controls phase gates.

synthesizer.name: Synthesizer
synthesizer.mid: Combines results from all agents into a coherent, complete output. Removes contradictions and duplicates.

analyst.name: Analyst
analyst.mid: Decomposes problems into measurable components. Identifies dependencies, risks, and success criteria.

planner.name: Planner
planner.mid: Creates phased project plans. Defines milestones, dependencies, and optimal workflow.

res_tech.name: Tech Researcher
res_tech.mid: Researches technical documentation, APIs, frameworks. Reports with confidence labels.

res_ux.name: UX Researcher
res_ux.mid: Studies UX patterns, design trends, and accessibility best practices.

res_reddit.name: Reddit Researcher
res_reddit.mid: Searches Reddit and community forums for user opinions and pain points.

res_x.name: X/Twitter Researcher
res_x.mid: Monitors X/Twitter discussions for trends and expert opinions.

res_github.name: GitHub Researcher
res_github.mid: Analyzes GitHub repositories, issues, PRs, and open source discussions.

res_forums.name: Forums Researcher
res_forums.mid: Searches technical forums (Stack Overflow, HN, Dev.to) for solutions.

res_docs.name: Docs Researcher
res_docs.mid: Analyzes official documentation, RFCs, specifications, and changelogs.

res_critic.name: Research Critic
res_critic.mid: Critically evaluates research results. Identifies gaps, contradictions, and bias.

backend.name: Backend Dev
backend.mid: Implements server logic, APIs, databases, and backend integrations.

frontend.name: Frontend Dev
frontend.mid: Implements user interfaces, React components, and API integrations.

feature.name: Feature Dev
feature.mid: Implements specific features and integrates new functionality into existing code.

designer.name: Designer
designer.mid: Designs UI/UX, creates design system, visual components, and styles.

integrator.name: Integrator
integrator.mid: Connects all system components. Ensures interface consistency and module communication.

writer.name: Writer
writer.mid: Creates technical documentation, READMEs, code comments, and user content.

qa_security.name: QA Security
qa_security.mid: Conducts security audits. Identifies vulnerabilities: XSS, SQL injection, OWASP Top 10.

qa_quality.name: QA Quality
qa_quality.mid: Tests code quality, test coverage, edge cases, and regressions.

qa_perf.name: QA Performance
qa_perf.mid: Profiles application performance. Identifies bottlenecks and optimizes critical paths.

qa_manager.name: QA Manager
qa_manager.mid: Coordinates QA work, compiles test reports, and issues GO/NO-GO recommendations.

expert_pragmatist.name: Pragmatist
expert_pragmatist.mid: Represents the practical perspective. 'Can this be done in a reasonable time?'

expert_innovator.name: Innovator
expert_innovator.mid: Represents the innovative perspective. Proposes unconventional solutions.

expert_analyst.name: Analyst Expert
expert_analyst.mid: Represents the analytical perspective. Requires evidence and measurable outcomes.

expert_user.name: User Advocate
expert_user.mid: Represents the user perspective. 'Does this solve the user's problem?'

expert_devil.name: Devil's Advocate
expert_devil.mid: Actively contests all proposals. Looks for flaws, contradictions, and hidden assumptions.

decision_presenter.name: Decision Presenter
decision_presenter.mid: Presents decision options to the user in a structured way. Collects HITL choices.

db_architect.name: DB Architect
db_architect.mid: Designs database schemas, indexes, and zero-downtime migrations.

observability_engineer.name: Observability Eng.
observability_engineer.mid: Implements observability (metrics, logs, traces). Defines SLI/SLO.

gtm_strategist.name: GTM Strategist
gtm_strategist.mid: Creates go-to-market strategy. Defines ICP, positioning, pricing, and launch plan.

statistician.name: Statistician
statistician.mid: Designs statistical experiments. Selects tests, calculates power, analyzes results.

eda_analyst.name: EDA Analyst
eda_analyst.mid: Conducts exploratory data analysis. Profiles data, detects anomalies and correlations.

control_mapper.name: Control Mapper
control_mapper.mid: Maps compliance requirements (GDPR, SOC2, ISO27001) to controls and gaps.

telemetry_surfer.name: Telemetry Surfer
telemetry_surfer.mid: Surfs production telemetry. Writes reproducible PromQL/LogQL queries.
